categories.main_business_segments: XD Inc. operates primarily in two segments: the game segment, which involves development, operation, publishing, and distribution of mobile and web games; and the TapTap platform segment, which provides an online game community and marketing services. The game segment includes both online free-to-play games with in-game virtual item sales and premium pay-to-play games. TapTap platform offers performance-based online marketing services to game developers and publishers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops games using advanced technologies including Unreal Engine and Unity, focusing on self-developed games and localized versions of licensed games. It employs AI recommendation technology for off-platform game promotion and integrates AI-powered Q&A modules into its TapTap platform. The company also emphasizes continuous R&D investment, with a large team dedicated to game development and innovation in game design and social dynamics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: XD Inc.'s primary customers include game players globally, game developers, and game publishers. Its games target various markets including Mainland China, Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, North America, Japan, and South Korea. The TapTap platform serves developers and publishers by providing marketing and distribution services, primarily in China and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant presence in Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, North America, Japan, South Korea, and other overseas markets. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Korea, and the Cayman Islands, supporting its global game publishing and platform services.
categories.supply_chain_position: XD Inc. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the gaming supply chain. It develops and publishes games (midstream) and operates the TapTap platform for game distribution and marketing (downstream). It acts as both principal and agent in various game publishing arrangements, managing game operation, marketing, and distribution channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes self-developed games and platform ecosystem integration, investing heavily in R&D with 724 employees in game development. It focuses on innovation in game genres like life simulation and ARPG, AI technology integration for game creation and marketing, and expanding cross-platform capabilities, especially PC gaming. TapTap platform development and AI-powered services like TapSight are key strategic initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from sales of in-game virtual items in online games (free-to-play model) and sales of premium pay-to-play games. The TapTap platform generates revenue through performance-based online marketing services. The company recognizes revenue on a gross or net basis depending on its role as principal or agent in game publishing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, XD Inc. positions itself as a leading game developer and publisher with a strong proprietary platform (TapTap) that differentiates it through exclusive content, AI-driven marketing, and cross-platform services. It competes in the global gaming market with a focus on innovation and community engagement.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: XD Inc. achieved over RMB5 billion in annual revenue for the first time in 2024, representing nearly 50% year-over-year growth. The company turned profitable with a net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB811.5 million in 2024, recovering from losses in prior years. The game segment revenue grew 64.2% year-on-year, and TapTap platform revenue increased 21.6%. The company maintains a strong cash position with RMB2.78 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: XD Inc. emphasizes high-quality self-developed games integrated with its TapTap platform ecosystem, offering unique game genres like life simulation and ARPG with strong social and community features. Its AI-driven marketing and off-platform promotion capabilities provide precise user acquisition and engagement. TapTap’s zero revenue share and non-co-publishing model attract developers by allowing them to retain full revenue, enhancing platform competitiveness and user experience.
